title: MasRouter: Learning to Route LLMs for Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Yanwei Yue; Guibin Zhang; Boyang Liu; Guancheng Wan; Kun Wang; Dawei Cheng; Yiyan Qi
venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2025

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM routing methods only choose a single best LLM per query for single-agent use, ignoring the collaboration-mode and agent-role decisions a multi-agent system (MAS) requires, while MAS pipelines incur large token/API overhead. The paper introduces "Multi-Agent System Routing" (MASR): for each query, jointly decide the collaboration mode, allocate agent roles, and assign an appropriate LLM to each agent so as to balance task performance and cost.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 LLM routing 方法僅針對每個 query 從候選中選擇單一最佳的 LLM 供 single-agent 使用,忽略了 multi-agent system (MAS) 所需的協作模式與 agent 角色決策,同時 MAS pipeline 亦帶來龐大的 token/API 開銷。本文提出「Multi-Agent System Routing」(MASR):針對每個 query,聯合決定協作模式、配置 agent 角色,並為每個 agent 指派適當的 LLM,以在任務效能與成本之間取得平衡。

key_innovation.en: MasRouter is a cascaded controller network that makes three sequential per-query decisions — collaboration mode (via a variational latent-variable / VAE-style model) then role allocation (structured probabilistic cascade) then per-agent LLM routing (multinomial distribution) — trained end-to-end by policy gradient (REINFORCE) on a performance-minus-lambda*cost objective, using a Gamma-function relaxation to keep the discrete agent count differentiable.
key_innovation.zh: MasRouter 為一個級聯式 (cascaded) controller 網路,針對每個 query 依序做出三項決策:先決定協作模式 (透過 variational latent-variable / VAE 式模型),再進行角色配置 (結構化機率級聯),最後為每個 agent 進行 LLM routing (multinomial distribution)。整體以 policy gradient (REINFORCE) 端到端訓練,最佳化目標為 performance 減去 lambda 乘上 cost;並採用 Gamma-function 鬆弛以維持離散 agent 數量的可微性。

baselines_compared: Vanilla single-agent, CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency SC, Chain, Tree, Complete Graph, LLM-Debate, GPTSwarm

key_improvements.en: MasRouter reaches 85.93 average across the five benchmarks, the best of all twenty baselines, surpassing RouterDC (82.42, the SOTA LLM-routing method) by 3.51% on average. Per-dataset: MMLU 84.25, GSM8K 95.45, MATH 75.42, HumanEval 90.62, MBPP 84.00. On MBPP it outperforms AgentPrune by 8.20% and AFlow by 1.80% at pass@1 (abstract: 1.8%-8.2% improvement over SOTA on MBPP).
key_improvements.zh: MasRouter 在五個 benchmark 上達到 85.93 的平均分數,為全部二十個 baseline 中的最佳,平均超越 RouterDC (82.42,即目前 SOTA 的 LLM-routing 方法) 3.51%。分項結果:MMLU 84.25、GSM8K 95.45、MATH 75.42、HumanEval 90.62、MBPP 84.00。在 MBPP 上,其 pass@1 較 AgentPrune 高 8.20%、較 AFlow 高 1.80% (摘要:於 MBPP 較 SOTA 提升 1.8%-8.2%)。其將 HumanEval 的開銷由 $0.363 降至 $0.185 (開銷最多可降低 52.07%)。歸納能力方面:在加入未見過的 DeepSeek-v3 後,其在 MMLU 有 12.17%、MATH 有 27.19% 的比例被選用,並使 MMLU 準確率由 84.25 提升至 85.40、HumanEval 由 90.62 提升至 91.41。消融實驗 (Table 3):移除 LLM router F_theta_m 造成最大幅度的下降 (GSM8K 下降 2.09%、MATH 下降 4.34%);移除 cost 項 C(.) 則使開銷增加 54.09% / 41.62%。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Roles / profiles, Team composition (agent set)
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Supernet controller sampling, Graph neural generator (GNN/VAE)
backbone_models: DeepSeek-v3 (held-out / unseen model used for inductive-generalization test)
gpt-3.5-turbo (appears only in Vanilla single-agent baseline table)

agent_scenario.en: General/multi-domain LLM-powered MAS. For each query a cascaded controller constructs the MAS: it picks a collaboration mode from the repository (CoT, Reflexion, self-consistency, MacNet-Chain, MacNet-Complete-Graph), decides the number of agents (up to gamma=6) adapted to query difficulty, assigns each agent a role from a 26-role pool (some tool-augmented, e.g. programmers with compilers, researchers with Wikipedia), and routes each agent to an LLM backbone drawn from a heterogeneous pool of 4 candidate LLMs. The agents then collaborate to solve knowledge (MMLU), math (GSM8K, MATH), and code (HumanEval, MBPP) tasks. Protocol: cascaded sampling collaboration-mode -> roles -> per-agent LLM, executed anew per query at inference.
agent_scenario.zh: 通用/跨領域的 LLM 驅動 MAS。針對每個 query,一個級聯式 controller 建構出該 MAS:自 repository 中挑選協作模式 (CoT、Reflexion、self-consistency、MacNet-Chain、MacNet-Complete-Graph),依 query 難度決定 agent 數量 (最多 gamma=6),自 26 種角色的池中為每個 agent 指派角色 (部分為 tool-augmented,例如配備 compiler 的 programmer、配備 Wikipedia 的 researcher),並將每個 agent route 至由 4 個候選 LLM 組成的異質池中所選出的 LLM backbone。這些 agent 隨後協作以解決知識 (MMLU)、數學 (GSM8K、MATH) 與程式 (HumanEval、MBPP) 任務。Protocol:級聯式取樣協作模式 -> 角色 -> 各 agent 的 LLM,於推論階段對每個 query 重新執行一次。
